title.en: Buying a product with a coupon (phone)

intro.sr: Standardan tok kupovine od početne stranice: klijent se registruje, u prodavnici bira proizvod, dodaje ga u korpu, primenjuje popust kuponom na naplati i potvrđuje porudžbinu. Pokazan je svaki klik. Snimljeno na telefonu (390x844).
intro.en: The standard purchase flow from the home page: a customer registers, picks a product in the shop, adds it to the cart, applies a coupon discount at checkout and confirms the order. Every click is shown. Recorded on a phone (390x844).
